description: A charming full-length outdoor portrait of a young baby or toddler seated barefoot on a pebble and leaf-strewn ground. The child wears a classic 1930s striped two-piece play suit or romper and clasps a small toy. In the background, dappled sunlight filters through lush tree foliage next to a simple wooden fence railing. The reverse features a development stamp from Whittier, California, dated August 1935.
